verdict.rationale: HMRC documents a sanctioned agent rail: an agent can sign a taxpayer up for Making Tax Digital, and agents have their own sign-up path and client-authorisation request links. MTD-compatible software is also a sanctioned provider channel. However, the evidence is one sentence scoped to Income Tax for sole traders and landlords, not to acting for a company. Missing for 10: documentation of company-level agent authorisation (e.g. for Corporation Tax, VAT or PAYE), details of how authorisation is granted, scoped and revoked, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
